text:
Ana K: Quick update — pivoting swag to a postcard + QR micro-giveaway for tonight's Sunset Salon to save table space and avoid shipping. Need routing for: postcard table, bag-drop, and lead handoff.
Mike L: got it. how many postcards and where are they stored? :point_up: 
Sophie R: ordered 250 postcards, printer confirmed delivery to lobby table by 17:45. i'll bring badge ribbons and a small tote.
Ana K: plan: 2 people at table (sign & scan), 1 floater to roam and qualify, 1 person to return remaining materials to office. Jared — you own slate handoff + QR scanner.
Jared T: can do slate/QR. do we have a short staff script so the messaging is consistent?
Mike L: drafting script now.
Mike L: Script v1:
```
1) Greet: "Hi! We're Redwood Inference — quick demo in 2 mins?"
2) Ask: "Are you building with LLMs or evaluating infra?"
3) Scan: "Can I grab your email? Scan QR to register and get a one-pager."
4) Tag: add `salon-sunset` to notes
5) Close: hand postcard + say "we'll follow up with benchmarks + trial credits"
```
Sophie R: tweak: if they say "no", drop postcard and ask permission to email. keeps it polite. :white_check_mark: 
Ana K: logistics: table at booth B7 by west stairs. green courier bag in conf storage has postcards and sharpies. Jared — you'll carry iPad + portable scanner (code: REDWOOD-QR).
Jared T: scanner battery tested. iPad offline cache preloaded. scanner points to sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEFghIJKlmnOPQ (staff read-only).
marketing-bot: Inventory update — postcards reserved: 250, handed to Sophie at 17:40. Reminder: update `swag-inventory` before end of night.
Mike L: Lead routing: spreadsheet -> Zap -> HubSpot. Tag = `salon-sunset-2024`. UTM for QR = `?utm_campaign=salon-sunset-2024&utm_source=postcard`. Jared confirm scanners append UTM.
Jared T: zap endpoint set. dry run with my phone created a row and HubSpot contact with tag.
Sophie R: packing timeline: 17:30 load postcards to green bag; 17:45 drop to west stairs table; 18:00 staff briefing at booth; 18:15 doors open.
Ana K: staff briefing checklist (short): roles (table1, table2, floater, slate); quick script; escalate to Ops if bag lost (call @mike); sticker color: "postcard" = blue dot on attendee list.
Mike L: i'll make a one-slide script + QR image for staff Slack. keep 10 extras reserved for speakers.
Sophie R: noted. leaving envelopes for partner follow-ups.
Ana K: follow-ups: add 1 example note in the sheet for any attendee mentioning "inference costs" or "private deployment" so Solutions can triage. tags: `costs`, `private-deploy`.
Jared T: adding a dropdown column to the sheet now.
Mike L: After-party pickup: return green bag + leftover postcards to 3rd floor ops closet by 23:30. if not possible, Sophie will courier next morning.
Sophie R: courier next morning OK.
Ana K: thanks team — short & clean. ping if anything breaks tonight. :pray:
